items.q: Can I cancel if my plans change?
items.a: Every tour can be cancelled for free. How late you can cancel differs per tour; the exact cut-off is on the tour page and in your confirmation email. No forms, no questions asked.

items.q: Do I have to pay in full now?
items.a: Usually not. Most tours reserve with a small deposit and you settle the rest later or on arrival, depending on the tour. A few tours charge in full or take nothing at booking; the tour page always states exactly how it works before you commit.

items.q: What happens if the operator has to cancel?
items.a: Weather and safety calls happen on real islands. When a tour is called off, you choose: your money back in full, or a free move to a new date.
Island Tours is run by ITG B.V., a company registered on Curaçao (KvK 169950). The people building and answering it live and work on the islands.
Message us on WhatsApp with who's coming and what you like. You get a short list of picks that fit, not a catalog dump.

about.title: About tours in {destination}
about.description: Every {destination} tour on Island Tours is picked by people who live here. We ride the tours ourselves, write each description from experience, and show the full price up front, with no surprise fees at checkout. Most tours hold your spot with a small deposit rather than the whole amount, and every one of them can be cancelled free within the window shown on its page. Booking is instant, so your confirmation arrives straight away, and if anything is unclear before you travel we answer on WhatsApp from 08:00 to 20:00.
